visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male host wearing a white chef's uniform stands in a warm indoor studio decorated with Chinese New Year couplets and wooden shelves. He holds a large purple gift box titled '2026瑞馬迎春年菜套組'. The scene is framed by a bright yellow graphic border. (2) The host stands behind a table laden with seven different dishes, including soups, stir-fries, and rice cakes. He gestures enthusiastically toward the camera while large yellow text overlays display early-bird pricing and free shipping details. (3) A close-up shows the host scooping large pieces of meat, mushrooms, and abalone from a white ceramic pot. The broth appears thick and dark. Subtitles identify the dish as '星廚極品 佛跳牆' with high-quality ingredients. (4) The camera focuses on a glossy, dark red braised pork hock on a white plate. The host uses chopsticks to lift a tender section of the skin, demonstrating its texture. Graphic overlays highlight the use of wine and plum flavors. (5) Close-up of fried fish nuggets coated in yellow curry sauce and topped with pink dried shrimp. The host takes a large bite, chewing with a visible expression of enjoyment. Subtitles label this dish as '春櫻土魠紅咖哩'. (6) A stir-fried vegetable dish with lotus roots, mushrooms, and Napa cabbage is shown in close-up. The host lifts a mushroom to show the sauce coverage. Subtitles emphasize the 'crunchy' and 'rich sesame' attributes of the dish. (7) A wooden ladle scoops a clear dark broth containing black chicken and radish slices. The host sips the soup from a small porcelain bowl, closing his eyes in satisfaction. Subtitles identify the 'old radish' and 'whelk' ingredients. (8) Close-up of a steamed rice cake garnished with sliced sausages, pine nuts, and truffle sauce. The host points at the varied textures with his chopsticks. Subtitles mention it is a recurring fan-favorite dish from the previous year. (9) The host pours white coconut milk into a bowl of dark red bean and purple rice soup. He scoops a spoonful toward the lens, smiling widely. Text overlays describe the flavor profile as 'sweet and savory'. (10) The host stands behind the full spread again, spreading his arms. A final graphic transition shows a promotion for Winnie the Pooh branded yellow cookware with a discount price, concluding with a call to action.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, fast-tempo electronic pop music begins instantly with a clear 4/4 drum beat. An energetic male voice introduces the dinner set with a bright, high-arousal tone. The mix is studio-clean with no ambient noise floor. (2) As the host starts describing the dishes, a digital 'pop' sound effect is synchronized with text appearing on screen. The speaker’s voice remains dominant and projected, exhibiting a rising intonation pattern to convey excitement about the large variety of dishes. (3) During the close-up of the Buddha Jumps Over the Wall, the sound of a ceramic spoon clinking against the pot is clearly audible, followed by a satisfied 'Ah~' vocalization from the host. The background music maintains its steady rhythmic pulse. (4) A rapid 'whoosh' transition SFX marks the shift to the pork hock section. The host's speech rate increases as he describes the flavor profile. The music swells slightly in frequency brightness during the highlight moments. (5) In the vegetable section, a crisp 'crunch' sound effect accompanies the host eating a piece of Napa cabbage. The music continues without pauses, providing a high-energy backdrop. (6) A 'ding' bell sound effect triggers when the price and free shipping offer are mentioned. The host's voice becomes more authoritative and persuasive. (7) The music concludes with a final synthesized chord swell as the host provides the call to action, pointing viewers toward the official website. The vocal intensity peaks during the final promotion of the cookware set.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Detailed Product Showcase -> Pricing/Incentive -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-energy promotional advertisement for the '2026瑞馬迎春年菜套組' by 料理123. It aims to generate early-bird sales by visually showcasing the abundance and premium quality of the six dishes and one dessert, paired with a limited-time discount and cross-promotion with Winnie the Pooh cookware.
